our_interpretation: Read as an empirical view about developers' net task-completion time, despite the conversational hedge.
Faster means less total time to complete comparable work to comparable quality, including prompting, checking, and rework.

A result in one narrow setting can support or challenge part of the claim without settling the general effect.
